visualReview: Inspected actual final APK screenshots for white Research, removed close controls, compact filled Gain action, Production feedback, Help focus outline and native footer text removal.
The native Rewards pane begins directly below the header; header taps remain reachable.
provenance: Root-only actual Android emulator. Loaded an ordinary previously saved Greenhaven Wave0 match to reuse its four real trucks, factories and labs. Native state/acknowledgements/completion IDs verified. Actual scaled Android taps, native minimap navigation and validated terrain picks; no seeded currency, spawned/debug units, synthetic production success or injected ad grant. Two native trucks and a GuardTower1 completed normally. The real Google sample ad followed the published Towers consent form, where Do not consent was chosen. All runtime identity observations bind the exact delivery APK.
limitations: Focused affected-flow verification only; no full campaign, all-map graphics pass, physical-phone test, live ad fill or advertising revenue is claimed.

The emulator already had missing terrain/texture rendering before this version; the authored map data and GL wrapper remain frozen. This change only suppresses the two identified native text render calls.

The native engine was incrementally source-built from an exactly matched prepared cache: one C++ object and link. Full native base source plus the exact guarded overlay and reproduction recipe are included.
Production Design/Blueprint-family header semantics also have actual-source host fixture coverage; the repeated device Production cycles used the Units page.

The emulator installation was data-retaining after available installation space fell below Android requirements. Wallet and saved-game data were preserved. An early test fixture queried page globals before load; its wait was corrected without changing app behavior.
